item.title: Implement token-bucket rate limiter per SPEC.md in ratelimit.py
item.brief:
Operator's words: "Implement the rate limiter described in `SPEC.md` in `ratelimit.py` (the module currently only has stubs). Follow the spec exactly, including its error cases and edge cases; the tests in `test_ratelimit.py` only cover the basics. Keep it dependency-free (standard library only) and commit your work."

Goal: make ratelimit.py fully implement SPEC.md (TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter, including the clock-goes-backwards rule and the max_keys behaviour). Acceptance criteria: every behaviour, error case and edge case in SPEC.md is implemented; existing tests in test_ratelimit.py pass; add tests for the spec's edge and error cases where practical; standard library only; commit the work on the item's branch. Keep functions under 60 lines and validate constructor and call arguments at the boundary.

model_reasons.implement: Small single-module spec with explicit edge cases; medium effort is enough for a balanced-tier author, and review is standard because the spec has subtle edge cases.

evidence.caption: Base commit d70b762: existing tests against stubs

pr.body: Approach: TokenBucket tracks float tokens and the latest clock time seen; refill only advances on forward time, so a backwards clock changes nothing. KeyedLimiter keeps an OrderedDict of buckets for LRU order; try_acquire and wait_time both touch the key; n and max_keys are validated before any key is created or evicted, so a bad call has no side effects. Key files: ratelimit.py, test_ratelimit.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest -v test_ratelimit, 21 tests OK at 880d878. Assumptions: clock callable is checked (TypeError); a non-finite clock reading raises ValueError; max_keys must be int (TypeError). Known gap (non-blocking, reviewer finding): wait_time may be one ulp short in ~0.3% of random cases.
pr.summary: Made rate limiting usable: TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter now implement SPEC.md. Now can gate calls per key with bounded memory (LRU eviction at max_keys) and correct clock-backwards handling. Before: stubs raising NotImplementedError; now: all 21 tests pass.
pr.title: Implement token-bucket rate limiter and keyed limiter

risk.why: New feature in a standalone module (ratelimit.py) with no concurrency, security or migration impact; behaviour is new but contained. Tests only, plus the module, changed. Review passed with one non-blocking ulp-precision follow-up.
